title: Health monitoring + error recovery + integration tests
description:
Add health monitoring, error recovery, and integration/concurrency tests per docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md §3.9-3.10, §6 Bead 3, §7.

Required reading: docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md

Key deliverables:
- internal/orchestrator/health.go — health monitor goroutine, per-session health checks (HTTP /health for remote agents), sandbox-host health checks (Node: RPC HealthCheck, Fleet: control-loop health)
- Unhealthy session state transitions and error surfacing to clients
- Integration with GetProcessStatus for agent crash detection
- Graceful shutdown improvements (drain active sessions before exit)
- Event fidelity verification tests for stream proxying (non-ID fields preserved after codec roundtrip)
- Concurrency tests: concurrent CreateSession across modes, concurrent SendMessage, DestroySession during streaming, health check concurrent with session ops, client cancel during streaming (no goroutine leaks), client cancel during slow provisioning (bounded cleanup), Close() cancels in-flight provisioning
- Integration test skeleton: tests/integration/orchestrator/ with build tag, real CreateSession+SendMessage+DestroySession cycle
- Race detector (make test-race) must pass clean

Depends on: Bead 2 (agent-sandbox + tools-sandbox)
